import { itemCritPenalty } from './item-catalog.js';
import {tuningPerk} from './tuning-parts.js';
import { createBitmapText } from './bitmap-font.js';
import { ensurePlayerStats } from './player-stats.js';

/** Shared stat labels, icons and formatting for Pause and Crafter screens. */
export const characterStatRows = [
  ['HP','Bond.png',p=>`${Math.ceil(p.hp)}/${p.maxHp}`],
  ['ATK','Tournament Water Gun.png',p=>`+${p.combatStats?.atkPercent||0}%`],
  ['SPD','Crew Whistle.png',p=>`+${(Number(p.combatStats?.spdPercent)||0)+(p.tuningParts?tuningPerk(p.tuningParts,'characterSpeedPercent'):0)}%`],
  ['CRT','Event 27 - 10 Sided Dice.png',p=>`${Number(Math.max(0,Math.min(100,Object.values(p.combatBuffs||{}).reduce((sum,buff)=>sum+(Number(buff?.critPercent)||0),(Number(p.combatStats?.critPercent)||0)-itemCritPenalty(p)))).toFixed(2))}%`],
  ['Pickup','Event 06 - Buff 14.png',p=>`+${p.combatStats?.pickupPercent||0}%`],
  ['Haste','Skill Book Node.png',p=>`+${p.combatStats?.hastePercent||0}%`]
];

/** Bind existing Pause markup, or build the identical holographic panel for another menu. */
export function createCharacterStatsPanel({root,portrait,nameCanvas,rowsContainer,scale=1}) {
  if(!portrait||!nameCanvas||!rowsContainer) {
    root.replaceChildren();
    portrait=document.createElement('img');portrait.className='pause-hologram';portrait.alt='';
    const content=document.createElement('div');content.className='pause-stat-content';
    nameCanvas=document.createElement('canvas');rowsContainer=document.createElement('div');
    content.append(nameCanvas,rowsContainer);root.append(portrait,content);
  }
  const name=createBitmapText(nameCanvas,{variant:'font2',scale:1.2*scale});
  rowsContainer.replaceChildren();
  const rows=characterStatRows.map(([label,file,value])=>{
    const row=document.createElement('div');row.className='pause-stat-row';
    const icon=document.createElement('img');icon.alt='';icon.src=`../sprites/icons/${file}`;
    const labelCanvas=document.createElement('canvas'),valueCanvas=document.createElement('canvas');
    const labelText=createBitmapText(labelCanvas,{variant:'font2',scale:1.1*scale});
    const valueText=createBitmapText(valueCanvas,{variant:'font2',scale:1.1*scale});
    labelText.setText(label);row.append(icon,labelCanvas,valueCanvas);rowsContainer.append(row);
    return {value,valueText};
  });
  return {
    /** Read the current character each time a menu opens; never reuse stale HP or bonuses. */
    update(player) {
      const character=ensurePlayerStats(player);name.setText(character.label||'Character');
      for(const row of rows)row.valueText.setText(row.value(character));
      const label=String(character.label||'').toLowerCase();
      const source=label.includes('plana')?'../sprites/Plana_Portrait.png':label.includes('arona')?'../sprites/Arona_Portrait.png':'';
      portrait.hidden=!source;if(source)portrait.src=source;
    }
  };
}

/** Create Supernova with independent automatic and EX attacks. */
export function createArisWeapon() {
  return { id: 'aris-laser', name: 'Supernova', icon: '../sprites/attacks/Weapon_Icon_Arisu.png',
    level: 1, iconRotation: -45, exSkill: true };
}

/** Find the equipped laser, independently of every other automatic weapon. */
export function getArisWeapon(player) {
  return player.attackSlots?.find(weapon => weapon?.id === 'aris-laser');
}

/** Size bonuses add to base width; level7 adds a rear beam to each volley. */
export function arisLevelStats(player) {
  const level = Math.max(1, Math.min(7, getArisWeapon(player)?.level || 1));
  return { level, size: 1 + (level >= 2 ? .3 : 0) + (level >= 6 ? .5 : 0),
    damage: level >= 4 ? 1.5 : 1,
    interval: arisWeaponSettings.attackInterval - (level >= 3 ? .5 : 0) - (level >= 5 ? .5 : 0),
    beams: level >= 7 ? 2 : 1 };
}

/** Roll the supplied27-33base damage range, then weapon levels and player ATK/crit. */
export function rollArisDamage(player, random = Math.random, target, damageMod = 1) {
  const s = arisWeaponSettings;
  return rollAttackDamage(player, totalWeaponDamage(player, 'aris-laser', s.damageMultiplier,
    [(arisLevelStats(player).damage - 1) * 100],
    { projectileCount: arisLevelStats(player).beams, hitCooldownFrames: s.hitCooldown * 60 }), random, { target, damageMod });
}

/** Invisible piercing capsule starts at the player, bridging the decorative muzzle gap. */
export function arisBeamHits(enemy, origin, angle, width, length = arisWeaponSettings.beamLength) {
  const body = getEnemyHurtbox(enemy);
  return segmentHitsBody({ ...body, rx: body.rx + width / 2, ry: body.ry + width / 2 },
    origin.x, origin.y, origin.x + Math.cos(angle) * length, origin.y + Math.sin(angle) * length);
}

/** Equip Kei's automatic weapon and its independent aura EX skill. */
export function createLuminousNovaWeapon() {
  return {id:'luminous-nova',name:'Luminous Nova',level:1,maxLevel:luminousNovaSettings.maxLevel,
    icon:'../sprites/attacks/Weapon_Icon_Kei.png',iconRotation:-45,exSkill:true};

export function getLuminousNova(player) {return player.attackSlots?.find(weapon=>weapon?.id==='luminous-nova');}

/** Fire-rate bonuses are absolute multiples of the base cycle, never cumulative multipliers. */
export function luminousNovaLevelStats(player) {
  const level=Math.max(1,Math.min(7,getLuminousNova(player)?.level||1));
  const fireRate=1+Number(level>=3)+Number(level>=5)+Number(level>=7);
  return {level,fireRate,interval:luminousNovaSettings.attackInterval/fireRate,
    damageMultiplier:(level>=2?1.2:1)*(level>=4?1.3:1),knockback:level>=6};
}

/** Damage levels multiply base damage; flat enhancements split over the base-cycle projectile count. */
export function rollLuminousNovaDamage(player,random=Math.random,target) {
  const stats=luminousNovaLevelStats(player);
  return rollAttackDamage(player,totalWeaponDamage(player,'luminous-nova',luminousNovaSettings.damageMultiplier,
    [(stats.damageMultiplier-1)*100],{projectileCount:stats.fireRate,hitCooldownFrames:10}),random,{target});
}

/** Sweep the spherical head so fast plasma rounds cannot tunnel past enemies. */
export function luminousNovaHits(enemy,from,to,radius=luminousNovaSettings.bulletDiameter/2*luminousNovaSettings.bloomRadiusScale) {
  const body=getEnemyHurtbox(enemy);
  return segmentHitsBody({...body,rx:body.rx+radius,ry:body.ry+radius},from.x,from.y,to.x,to.y);
}

  const success=random()<choice.chance;
  if(success)target.enhancementRank=choice.rank;
  return {consumed:true,success,message:success?`${choice.name} enhanced to +${choice.rank}!`:`Enhancement failed. ${choice.cost} Credits and the Crafter were consumed.`};
}

/** Advance one weapon level; awakening is available only through a Crafter. */
export function applyLevelUpgrade(player, id) {
  ensurePlayerStats(player);
  if (player.pendingUpgrades <= 0 || !rollLevelUpgrades(player).some(choice => choice.id === id)) return false;
  if(id.startsWith('malkuth-')) {if(!applyItemUpgrade(player,id))return false;player.pendingUpgrades--;return true;}
  const weapon = id.startsWith('luminous-')?getLuminousNova(player):id.startsWith('aris-') ? getArisWeapon(player) : getUmbrella(player);
  if (id === 'aris-new'||id==='luminous-new') {
    player.attackSlots ??= [];
    const empty = player.attackSlots.findIndex(item => !item);
    const acquired=id==='luminous-new'?createLuminousNovaWeapon():createArisWeapon();
    if (empty >= 0) player.attackSlots[empty] = acquired;
    else player.attackSlots.push(acquired);
  } else if (id === 'aris-level') weapon.level = Math.min(arisWeaponSettings.maxLevel, (weapon.level || 1) + 1);
  else if(id==='luminous-level')weapon.level=Math.min(luminousNovaSettings.maxLevel,(weapon.level||1)+1);
  else if (id === 'umbrella-level') weapon.level = Math.min(umbrellaUpgradeSettings.maxLevel, (weapon.level || 1) + 1);
  else return false;
  recordWeaponMax(player,weapon);
  player.pendingUpgrades--;
  return true;
}

/** Persistent miasma: renewal replaces the old field and never overlaps another copy. */
export function createBadCookingAttack({random=Math.random}={}){
  let owner=null,active=false,enabled=true,elapsed=0,cycle=0,time=0,hits=new Map(),mist=null;
  function reset(){owner=null;active=false;elapsed=0;cycle=0;time=0;hits.clear();}
  function update(delta,player){
    const weapon=player.attackSlots?.find(w=>w?.id==='bad-cooking');
    if(!weapon){reset();return;}if(owner!==player){reset();owner=player;}
    if(delta<=0)return;if(!enabled){active=false;return;}
    active=true;elapsed=(elapsed+delta)%badCookingSettings.interval;cycle+=delta;
    const stats=badCookingLevelStats(weapon.level),radius=stats.radius*Math.max(0,player.weaponAreaMultiplier??1);
    const body=getCombatHitbox(player,false);
    let left=delta;
    while(left>1e-8){const step=Math.min(left,1/60);left-=step;time+=step;
      const enemies=getAllEnemies(),liveIds=new Set(enemies.map(e=>e.id));
      for(const id of hits.keys())if(!liveIds.has(id))hits.delete(id);
      for(const enemy of enemies){
        if(time-(hits.get(enemy.id)??-Infinity)<stats.hitCooldown-1e-8)continue;
        const target=getEnemyHurtbox(enemy),dx=body.x-target.x,dy=body.y-target.y;
        // Closest point on the sprite hurtbox, rather than contact hitbox.
        const distance=Math.hypot(dx,dy),extent=distance?1/Math.hypot(dx/distance/target.rx,dy/distance/target.ry):0;
        if(distance>radius+extent)continue;
        hits.set(enemy.id,time);
        const hit=rollAttackDamage(player,totalWeaponDamage(player,'bad-cooking',badCookingSettings.damage,stats.damageBonuses,
          {projectileCount:1,hitCooldownFrames:stats.hitCooldown*60}),random,{target:enemy,weaponId:'bad-cooking'});
        const landed=damageEnemy(enemy.id,hit.damage,player,hit.type,{canMiss:true}),living=getEnemy(enemy.id);
        if(stats.knockback&&landed!==false&&living){const angle=Math.atan2(-dy,-dx),duration=badCookingSettings.knockbackSeconds;
          applySkillControl(living,Math.cos(angle)*badCookingSettings.knockbackSpeed*duration,Math.sin(angle)*badCookingSettings.knockbackSpeed*duration,duration,duration);}
      }
    }
  }
  function draw(context,camera){
    if(!active||!owner)return;
    if(!mist){mist=document.createElement('canvas');mist.width=mist.height=128;const c=mist.getContext('2d'),g=c.createRadialGradient(64,64,0,64,64,64);
      g.addColorStop(0,'rgba(157,103,176,.2)');g.addColorStop(.45,'rgba(112,155,81,.3)');g.addColorStop(.75,'rgba(97,73,129,.2)');g.addColorStop(1,'rgba(100,90,120,0)');c.fillStyle=g;c.fillRect(0,0,128,128);}
    const body=getCombatHitbox(owner,false),weapon=owner.attackSlots.find(w=>w?.id==='bad-cooking');
    const radius=badCookingLevelStats(weapon?.level).radius*Math.max(0,owner.weaponAreaMultiplier??1),x=body.x-camera.x,y=body.y-camera.y;
    context.save();context.globalAlpha=Math.min(1,cycle/.3);
    context.drawImage(mist,x-radius,y-radius,radius*2,radius*2);
    for(let i=0;i<10;i++){const angle=i*2.399+cycle*.17,r=radius*(.25+.4*((i%3)/2)),size=radius*(.65+.1*Math.sin(cycle*1.3+i));
      context.drawImage(mist,x+Math.cos(angle)*r-size/2,y+Math.sin(angle)*r-size/2,size,size);}
    context.restore();
  }
  return {ready:Promise.resolve(),update,draw,reset,setAutoattackEnabled(value){enabled=Boolean(value);if(!enabled)active=false;},get active(){return active;}};

/** Run-scoped, non-magnetic Crafter drops and the paused, cancellable upgrade menu. */
export function createCrafterSystem({getPlayer,canvas,onOpen=()=>{},onChange=()=>{},onResult=()=>{},golden=false,getMinuteTimer=()=>0}) {
  const drops=new Map();let nextId=0,active=null;const reentry=createPickupReentryGuard();
  const toast=document.createElement('div');toast.className='crafter-toast';toast.setAttribute('role','status');toast.hidden=true;canvas.parentElement.append(toast);let toastTimer;
  const icon=new Image();icon.src=crafterSettings.icon.source;
  const ready=icon.decode();
  /** Closing an unused Crafter requires full separation plus 1.5 seconds before reopening. */
  function close() {if(active!==null&&drops.has(active))reentry.block(active);active=null;menu.close();canvas.focus({preventScroll:true});}
  const menu=createCrafterMenu({canvas,getPlayer,golden,onCancel:close,onAction:id=>{
    if(active===null||!drops.has(active))return;
    const result=golden?applyGoldenCrafterChoice(getPlayer(),id):applyCrafterChoice(getPlayer(),id);
    if(!result.consumed){menu.refresh();return;}
    drops.delete(active);close();onChange();
    // Successful fusion is shown directly by the new inventory weapon, without an alert.
    if(golden&&result.success)return;
    onResult(result.message);
    toast.textContent=result.message;toast.hidden=false;clearTimeout(toastTimer);toastTimer=setTimeout(()=>{toast.hidden=true},4000);
  }});
  function open(drop) {active=drop.id;onOpen();menu.open();}
  /** Place on safe ground, respecting the twenty-Crafter limit even for test drops. */
  function spawn(x,y) {
    if(drops.size>=(golden?crafterSettings.goldenMaxGround:crafterSettings.maxGround))return false;
    const point=safeDropLanding(x,y);if(!point)return false;

def digest(data):
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()


def find_sources(home):
    found = []
    for base in [home / 'sessions', home / 'archived_sessions']:
        if not base.exists():
            continue
        for path in base.rglob('*.jsonl'):
            try:
                with path.open(encoding='utf-8') as stream:
                    first = json.loads(stream.readline())
                meta = first.get('payload', {})
                if first.get('type') == 'session_meta':
                    source = meta.get('source', {})
                    spawn = source.get('subagent', {}).get('thread_spawn', {}) if isinstance(source, dict) else {}
                    found.append((path, meta.get('id'), spawn.get('parent_thread_id'), spawn.get('agent_path')))
            except (OSError, ValueError):
                continue
    ids = {THREAD}
    while True:
        expanded = ids | {ident for _, ident, parent, _ in found if parent in ids}
        if expanded == ids:
            break
        ids = expanded
    return sorted((item for item in found if item[1] in ids), key=lambda item: str(item[0]))


def content_text(content):
    if isinstance(content, str):
        return content
    if not isinstance(content, list):
        return ''
    return '\n'.join(part.get('text', '') for part in content if isinstance(part, dict) and part.get('type', '').lower() in {'text', 'input_text', 'output_text'})


def safe_payload(payload):
    # Retain visible/tool content, not private runtime metadata or reasoning records.
    return {key: value for key, value in payload.items() if key not in {'internal_chat_message_metadata_passthrough', 'logprobs'}}

VERBATIM AGGREGATED_OUTPUT:
    db.execute('CREATE INDEX record_message_hash ON records(text_hash,kind,timestamp)')

class Writer:
    def __init__(self, path):
        self.file = path.open('wb')
        self.line = 1
        self.sections = []

    def write(self, text):
        self.file.write(text.encode('utf-8'))
        self.line += text.count('\n')

    def section(self, title):
        self.sections.append({'title': title, 'line': self.line, 'byte': self.file.tell()})
        self.write('\n' + '=' * 78 + '\n' + title + '\n' + '=' * 78 + '\n')


def write_record(writer, row, number):
    _, timestamp, source, source_line, scope, kind, role, phase, encoded, _ = row
    payload = json.loads(encoded)
    entry = {'number': number, 'timestamp': timestamp, 'scope': scope, 'kind': kind, 'role': role, 'phase': phase,
             'line': writer.line, 'byte': writer.file.tell(), 'source': source, 'source_line': source_line,
             'source_id': payload.get('id')}
    writer.write(f'\n--- RECORD {number:06d} | {timestamp} | {scope} | {kind} {role} {phase} ---\nSOURCE: {source}:{source_line}\n')
    if role:
        text = content_text(payload.get('content', []))
        writer.write(text + '\n')
        entry['preview'] = text[:180].replace('\n', ' ')
        # Full content retains non-text attachments as recorded, without truncation.
        writer.write('\nFULL RECORDED MESSAGE (JSON; includes attachment blocks when present):\n')
        writer.write(json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n')
    else:
        writer.write(json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n')
        for key in ['input', 'command', 'arguments', 'aggregated_output', 'stdout', 'stderr', 'output']:
            value = payload.get(key)
            if isinstance(value, str) and value:
                writer.write(f'\nVERBATIM {key.upper()}:\n{value}\n')
        if payload.get('type') == 'FileChange':
            for name, change in payload.get('changes', {}).items():
                if not isinstance(change, dict):
                    continue
                for field in ['diff', 'content', 'patch']:
                    if isinstance(change.get(field), str):
                        writer.write(f'\nVERBATIM FILE CHANGE | {name} | {field}:\n{change[field]}\n')
    return entry


def export_git(writer):
    result = {}
    commands = [
        ('Git commit history and recorded line-level patches', ['git', 'log', '--all', '--reverse', '--root', '--format=fuller', '-p', '--no-ext-diff', '--', '.', ':(exclude)sprites/**', ':(exclude)Audio/**', ':(exclude)chat_log.txt', ':(exclude)Memroy Activity Log*']),
        ('Current tracked working-tree patch (not an attribution of every line to the assistant)', ['git', 'diff', 'HEAD', '--no-ext-diff', '--', '.', ':(exclude)sprites/**', ':(exclude)Audio/**', ':(exclude)chat_log.txt', ':(exclude)Memroy Activity Log*']),
        ('Current repository status', ['git', 'status', '--short'])]
    for title, command in commands:
        writer.section(title)
        writer.write('COMMAND: ' + ' '.join(command) + '\n')
        process = subprocess.run(command, cwd=ROOT, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
        writer.write(process.stdout.decode('utf-8', 'replace'))
        error = process.stderr.decode('utf-8', 'replace')
        if error:
            writer.write('\nGIT STDERR:\n' + error)
        result[title] = {'exit_code': process.returncode}
    return result


def snapshot(writer):
    writer.section('Current text/source files, verbatim baseline for future line-by-line comparisons')
    files = []
    ignored_dirs = {'.git', 'node_modules', '.codex', '.agents', '.aws', '.venv', '__pycache__', 'Audio', 'sprites'}
    for folder, dirs, names in os.walk(ROOT):
        dirs[:] = sorted(name for name in dirs if name not in ignored_dirs)
        for name in sorted(names):
            path = Path(folder) / name
            relative = path.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix()
            if name.startswith('Memroy Activity Log') or name == 'chat_log.txt' or path.suffix.lower() not in CODE_SUFFIXES:
                continue
            raw = path.read_bytes()
            if b'\x00' in raw:
                continue
            try:
                text, encoding = raw.decode('utf-8-sig'), 'utf-8-sig'
            except UnicodeDecodeError:
                text, encoding = raw.decode('cp1252', 'replace'), 'cp1252 (mixed historical files may contain legacy encoding)'
            item = {'path': relative, 'bytes': len(raw), 'sha256': digest(raw), 'encoding': encoding, 'line': writer.line, 'byte': writer.file.tell()}
            files.append(item)
            writer.write(f'\n--- SNAPSHOT FILE: {relative} | sha256={item["sha256"]} | encoding={encoding} ---\n')
            writer.write(text + ('\n' if not text.endswith('\n') else ''))
            if encoding != 'utf-8-sig':
                writer.write('RAW ORIGINAL BYTES (BASE64; exact mixed-encoding source):\n'+base64.b64encode(raw).decode('ascii')+'\n')
    return files


def build(home, final_response=None):
    sources = find_sources(home)
    if not any(ident == THREAD for _, ident, _, _ in sources):
        raise SystemExit('The original chat archives were not found; no log was overwritten.')
    generated = dt.datetime.now(dt.timezone.utc).isoformat()
    temp = LOG.with_suffix('.building')
    with contextlib.closing(sqlite3.connect(':memory:')) as db:
        reports = ingest(db, sources)
        counts = dict(db.execute('SELECT kind || CASE WHEN role != "" THEN ":" || role ELSE "" END, count(*) FROM records GROUP BY kind,role'))
        writer = Writer(temp)
        writer.write('MEMROY ACTIVITY LOG\nOriginal chat: Friday, October 30, 2026 at 8:54 AM America/Vancouver\n')
        writer.write('Opening request: "For the first step, could you create a txt file that logs all prompts, responses, changes and chat logs there"\n')
        writer.write(f'Thread: {THREAD}\nGenerated UTC: {generated}\nCompanion searchable index: Memroy Activity Log.index.json\nRefresh: python tools/update_memory_activity_log.py\n\n')
        writer.write('READ THIS FIRST\nThis is a source-backed archive, not a condensed replacement for the conversation. It preserves available user and visible assistant messages, questions, tool calls/results, recorded file-change patches, and code-writing commands. Supporting tool-event mirrors are deliberately retained. Original source paths/line numbers are provided for auditing.\n')
        writer.write('Refresh after future work: python tools/update_memory_activity_log.py\nThe source archives are read-only; this tool only rebuilds the workspace archive and its index. Regeneration captures later records, including previous refresh results. Source-truncated text is never silently filled in.\n')
        sections = writer.sections
        writer.file.close()
        os.replace(temp, LOG)
        archive_hash = hashlib.sha256()
        with LOG.open('rb') as stream:
            while block := stream.read(1024 * 1024):
                archive_hash.update(block)
        index = {'thread_id': THREAD, 'generated_utc': generated, 'log': LOG.name, 'bytes': LOG.stat().st_size, 'sha256': archive_hash.hexdigest(),
                 'records': len(entries), 'source_counts': counts, 'presentation_mirrors_suppressed': skipped_mirrors, 'sources': reports,
                 'sections': sections, 'entries': entries, 'snapshot_files': files, 'git': git, 'chat_log_sha256': old_hash}
        INDEX.write_text(json.dumps(index, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding='utf-8')
        db.close()
        print(json.dumps({'log': str(LOG), 'bytes': index['bytes'], 'records': len(entries), 'snapshot_files': len(files), 'sources': len(reports),
                          'parse_errors': sum(len(r['parse_errors']) for r in reports), 'sha256': index['sha256']}, indent=2))


if __name__ == '__main__':
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--codex-home', type=Path, default=Path.home()/'.codex')
    parser.add_argument('--final-response', help='Exact prepared visible final response, captured before it is sent.')
    args = parser.parse_args()
    build(args.codex_home, args.final_response)

/** Load predecoded GIF display frames while retaining original frame durations. */
export async function loadGifAnimation(character) {
  character.animationFrames = await Promise.all(character.gifFrames.map(frame =>
    new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      const image = new Image();
      image.onload = () => resolve({ image, duration: frame.duration });
      image.onerror = () => reject(new Error(`Could not load ${frame.source}.`));
      image.src = frame.source;
    })
  ));
  character.image = character.animationFrames[0].image;
}

/** Select the original GIF frame for elapsed playback time, including while idle. */
export function gifFrameAt(frames, elapsed) {
  const total = frames.reduce((sum, frame) => sum + frame.duration, 0);
  let time = elapsed % total;
  for (let i = 0; i < frames.length; i++) {
    time -= frames[i].duration;
    if (time < 0) return i;
  }
  return 0;

  goldenCrafters?.draw(context,camera,canvas.width,canvas.height);
  else if(!blocked.has('luminous-nova')&&luminous&&(luminous.level||1)<luminousNovaSettings.maxLevel)choices.push({
    id:'luminous-level',name:`Luminous Nova ${upgradeLevelLabel(luminous,luminousNovaSettings.maxLevel)}`,weapon:luminous,category:'Weapon',
    description:luminousDescriptions[(luminous.level||1)+1]});
  const cooking=player.attackSlots?.find(w=>w?.id==='bad-cooking');
  if(!blocked.has('bad-cooking')&&!player.disabledWeaponIds?.includes('bad-cooking')){
    if(!cooking&&(player.attackSlots||[]).filter(Boolean).length<6)choices.push({id:'cooking-new',name:'Bad Cooking LV 1',weapon:createBadCookingWeapon(),category:'NEW Weapon',description:badCookingDescriptions[1]});
    else if(cooking&&(cooking.level||1)<7)choices.push({id:'cooking-level',name:`Bad Cooking ${upgradeLevelLabel(cooking,7)}`,weapon:cooking,category:'Weapon',description:badCookingDescriptions[(cooking.level||1)+1]});
  }
  // Synergies improve only through Crafter enhancements, never level-up choices.
  choices.push(...itemUpgradeChoices(player));
  return choices.filter(choice=>!choice.weapon?.isSynergy&&!player.eliminatedUpgradeIds?.includes(choice.weapon?.id||choice.id)).slice(0, all?Infinity:levelUpgradeSettings.choices);
}

/** Advance one weapon level; awakening is available only through a Crafter. */
export function applyLevelUpgrade(player, id) {
  ensurePlayerStats(player);
  if (player.pendingUpgrades <= 0 || !rollLevelUpgrades(player,{all:true}).some(choice => choice.id === id)) return false;
  if(id==='cooking-new'||id==='cooking-level'){
    player.attackSlots??=[];
    if(id==='cooking-new'){const empty=player.attackSlots.findIndex(w=>!w);if(empty>=0)player.attackSlots[empty]=createBadCookingWeapon();else player.attackSlots.push(createBadCookingWeapon());}
    else {const w=player.attackSlots.find(w=>w?.id==='bad-cooking');w.level++;recordWeaponMax(player,w);}
    player.pendingUpgrades--;return true;
  }
  if(id.startsWith('malkuth-')) {if(!applyItemUpgrade(player,id))return false;player.pendingUpgrades--;return true;}
  const weapon = id.startsWith('luminous-')?getLuminousNova(player):id.startsWith('aris-') ? getArisWeapon(player) : getUmbrella(player);
  if (id === 'aris-new'||id==='luminous-new') {
    player.attackSlots ??= [];
    const empty = player.attackSlots.findIndex(item => !item);
    const acquired=id==='luminous-new'?createLuminousNovaWeapon():createArisWeapon();
    if (empty >= 0) player.attackSlots[empty] = acquired;
    else player.attackSlots.push(acquired);
  } else if (id === 'aris-level') weapon.level = Math.min(arisWeaponSettings.maxLevel, (weapon.level || 1) + 1);
  else if(id==='luminous-level')weapon.level=Math.min(luminousNovaSettings.maxLevel,(weapon.level||1)+1);
  else if (id === 'umbrella-level') weapon.level = Math.min(umbrellaUpgradeSettings.maxLevel, (weapon.level || 1) + 1);
  else return false;
  recordWeaponMax(player,weapon);
  player.pendingUpgrades--;
  return true;
}

import { molotovSettings, molotovLevelStats, attackTimeFormula } from './game-config.js';
import { ensureCombatStats, totalWeaponDamage, rollAttackDamage } from './combat-stats.js';
import { stationaryWeaponIntervalScale } from './tuning-parts.js';
import { getAllEnemies, damageEnemy } from './world-state.js';
import { getCombatHitbox, getEnemyHurtbox } from './combat-hitboxes.js';
import { molotovAnimationReady, drawMolotovNapalm } from './molotov-animation.js';

/** Distance fraction: mid-range peak, moderate close throws, a thin far-range tail. */
export function molotovThrowDistance(random=Math.random){
 const min=.05,max=1,mode=.45,u=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,random())),split=(mode-min)/(max-min);
 return u<split?min+Math.sqrt(u*(max-min)*(mode-min)):max-Math.sqrt((1-u)*(max-min)*(max-mode));
}

export function createMolotovAttack({random=Math.random}={}){
 let owner=null,cooldown=0,time=0,enabled=true,throws=[],fires=[],shots=0;
 function reset(){owner=null;cooldown=0;time=0;throws=[];fires=[];shots=0;}
 function launch(player,stats,viewport){
  const body=getCombatHitbox(player,false),view=viewport||{x:body.x-640,y:body.y-360,width:1280,height:720};
  const pad=Math.max(view.width,view.height)*.15;
  const enemies=getAllEnemies().filter(enemy=>{const b=getEnemyHurtbox(enemy);return b.x>=view.x-pad&&b.x<=view.x+view.width+pad&&b.y>=view.y-pad&&b.y<=view.y+view.height+pad;});
  for(let i=0;i<stats.count;i++){
   // Enemies can bias direction; their distance never bypasses the weighted range roll.
   const target=enemies.length&&random()<.7?getEnemyHurtbox(enemies[Math.min(enemies.length-1,Math.floor(random()*enemies.length))]):null;
   const angle=target?Math.atan2(target.y-body.y,target.x-body.x)+(random()-.5)*.3:random()*Math.PI*2;
   const dx=Math.cos(angle),dy=Math.sin(angle);
   const edgeX=Math.abs(dx)>1e-8?((dx>0?view.x+view.width+pad:view.x-pad)-body.x)/dx:Infinity;
   const edgeY=Math.abs(dy)>1e-8?((dy>0?view.y+view.height+pad:view.y-pad)-body.y)/dy:Infinity;
   const distance=Math.max(20,Math.min(edgeX,edgeY))*molotovThrowDistance(random);
   const x=body.x+dx*distance,y=body.y+dy*distance;
   throws.push({x:body.x,y:body.y,fromX:body.x,fromY:body.y,toX:x,toY:y,age:0,
    flight:Math.max(.12,Math.hypot(x-body.x,y-body.y)/molotovSettings.speed),
    radius:stats.radius*Math.max(0,player.weaponAreaMultiplier??1),duration:stats.duration,damageBonuses:stats.damageBonuses,count:stats.count});shots++;
  }
 }
 function update(delta,player,viewport=null){
  const weapon=player.attackSlots?.find(w=>w?.id==='molotov-cocktail');if(!weapon){reset();return;}
  if(owner!==player){reset();owner=player;}if(delta<=0)return;
  let left=delta;
  while(left>1e-8){
   if(enabled&&cooldown<=1e-8){launch(player,molotovLevelStats(weapon.level),viewport);cooldown=attackTimeFormula(molotovSettings.interval*(player.tuningParts?stationaryWeaponIntervalScale(player):1),ensureCombatStats(player).hastePercent);}
   const step=Math.min(left,1/60,enabled&&cooldown>1e-8?cooldown:1/60);left-=step;time+=step;cooldown=Math.max(0,cooldown-step);
   for(let i=throws.length-1;i>=0;i--){const b=throws[i];b.age+=step;const progress=Math.min(1,b.age/b.flight);b.x=b.fromX+(b.toX-b.fromX)*progress;b.y=b.fromY+(b.toY-b.fromY)*progress;
    if(progress>=1){fires.push({...b,x:b.toX,y:b.toY,age:0,hits:new Map()});throws.splice(i,1);}}
   const enemies=getAllEnemies(),living=new Set(enemies.map(e=>e.id));
   for(let i=fires.length-1;i>=0;i--){const zone=fires[i];zone.age+=step;
    if(zone.age>=zone.duration){fires.splice(i,1);continue;}
    for(const id of zone.hits.keys())if(!living.has(id))zone.hits.delete(id);
    for(const enemy of enemies){if(time-(zone.hits.get(enemy.id)??-Infinity)<molotovSettings.hitCooldown-1e-8)continue;

## Behavior

When equipped, most weapons that deal damage in a radius around a character or create an area of effect when used have their radius increased. For example, if a weapon creates spinning objects around the character, the size of the objects and their spinning radius increases; meanwhile, if a weapon shoots projectiles, the size of the projectiles increase. Racer Pass's attack size bonus stacks additively with the bonus from [Skill not added yet from another]



Additionally, some Skills and Special Attack are affected by Racer Pass. Like weapons, their size and/or area of effect are increased.

/** List only equipped targets, keeping upgrades capped and offering only defined awakening paths. */
export function crafterChoices(player) {
  const choices=[],loot=getLootTotals();
  for(const [kind,slots] of [['weapon',player.attackSlots||[]],['item',player.equipmentSlots||[]]]) {
    slots.forEach((target,index)=>{

      const max=target.id==='plana-umbrella'?umbrellaUpgradeSettings.maxLevel:

      if(!Number.isFinite(max))return;
      const prefix=`${kind}:${index}`,name=target.name||target.id||'Item',level=target.level||1;
      if(!target.isSynergy&&level<max)choices.push({id:`${prefix}:level`,target,kind,name,label:`Upgrade to LV ${level+1}`,cost:0,disabled:false});
      else if(kind==='weapon') {
        const rank=(target.enhancementRank||0)+1,cost=crafterEnhancementCost(rank);
        const chance=crafterEnhancementChance(rank,player.enhancementRateBonusPercent||0);
        choices.push({id:`${prefix}:enhance`,target,kind,name,label:`Enhance +${rank} â€” ${cost} Credits â€” ${Math.round(chance*100)}% success`,cost,chance,rank,disabled:loot.credits<cost});
      }
      if(kind==='item'&&target.id==='malkuth-hat'&&level>=max&&!target.awakened)
        choices.push({id:`${prefix}:awaken`,target,kind,name,label:'Awaken - 1 Secret Tech Note',disabled:loot.secretTechNotes<1});
      const main=player.mainWeaponId??(player.label==='Plana'?'plana-umbrella':null);
      if(kind==='weapon'&&target.id==='plana-umbrella'&&main===target.id&&level>=max&&!target.awakened) {

      }
    });
  }
  return choices;
}

import { umbrellaUpgradeSettings, umbrellaSettings } from './game-config.js';
import { rollAttackDamage, totalWeaponDamage, startingWeaponTuning } from './combat-stats.js';

/** Locate Plana's equipped umbrella without selecting or switching active weapons. */
export function getUmbrella(player) {
  return player.attackSlots?.find(weapon => weapon?.id === 'plana-umbrella');
}

/** Cumulative weapon-level bonuses; awakening is a separate state after level seven. */
export function umbrellaLevelStats(player) {
  const level = Math.max(1, Math.min(umbrellaUpgradeSettings.maxLevel, getUmbrella(player)?.level || 1));
  const damageTiers = Number(level >= 2) + Number(level >= 5);
  const areaTiers = Number(level >= 3) + Number(level >= 6);
  return {
    level, damageMultiplier: (1 + umbrellaUpgradeSettings.damageIncrease) ** damageTiers,
    areaScale: Math.sqrt(1 + areaTiers * umbrellaUpgradeSettings.areaIncrease) *
      (1+(player.tuningParts?startingWeaponTuning(player,'plana-umbrella','attackSizePercent'):0)/100),
    intervalMultiplier: (level >= 4 ? umbrellaUpgradeSettings.intervalMultiplier : 1) *
      (1-(player.tuningParts?startingWeaponTuning(player,'plana-umbrella','attackTimeReductionPercent'):0)/100),
    guaranteedCritical: level >= 7,
    awakened: Boolean(getUmbrella(player)?.awakened)
  };
}

  function advance(delta,player) {

      const bullet=bullets[i],step=Math.min(delta,s.duration-bullet.age),from={x:bullet.x,y:bullet.y};

            s.knockbackSeconds,s.knockbackSeconds);
        }
      }

/** Inclusive integer rolls and the supplied nested-floor Credits formula. */
export function fileCredits(type,random=Math.random,moneyUpBonus=0,stageMultiplier=1) {
  const [a,b]=type==='super'?[399,5]:type==='triple'?[399,3]:[301,1];
  const integer=max=>Math.min(max,Math.floor(random()*(max+1)));
  const multiplier=(1+moneyUpBonus/100)*stageMultiplier;
  return Math.floor(Math.floor(a/(3+integer(2)))*multiplier*(1+b*(20+integer(10))/100*multiplier));
}

/** Apply one accepted product without spending level-up choices; dropping never applies it. */
export function acceptFileProduct(player,product) {
  const slots=product.kind==='item'?(player.equipmentSlots??=[]):(player.attackSlots??=[]);
  const owned=slots.find(item=>item?.id===product.weapon.id);
  if(owned) {
    if(product.kind==='item'&&owned.id==='malkuth-hat'&&product.weapon.awakened&&!owned.awakened){Object.assign(owned,createMalkuthHat(true));return true;}
    if(owned.isSynergy)return false;
    const max=owned.maxLevel||7;if((owned.level||1)>=max)return false;
    owned.level=(owned.level||1)+1;if(product.kind!=='item')recordWeaponMax(player,owned);return true;
  }
  const index=slots.findIndex(item=>!item);
  if(index<0&&slots.filter(Boolean).length>=6)return false;
  const item={...product.weapon};if(index>=0)slots[index]=item;else slots.push(item);return true;
}

/** Generate products using a shadow inventory so triple rewards cannot overfill or overlevel it. */
export function rollFileRewards(player,{random=Math.random,forceType,getOptions=rollLevelUpgrades,superItems=superFileItems}={}) {
  const roll=random();let type=forceType||(roll<fileSettings.superChance?'super':roll<fileSettings.superChance+fileSettings.tripleChance?'triple':'normal');
  const supers=superItems.filter(item=>{
    if(!isItemRewardEnabled(player,item.id))return false;
    const owned=player.equipmentSlots?.find(owned=>owned?.id===item.id);
    if(item.id==='malkuth-hat'&&!isItemUnlocked(item.id)&&!owned)return false;
    return owned?item.id==='malkuth-hat'&&!owned.awakened:(player.equipmentSlots||[]).filter(Boolean).length<6;
  });
  if(type==='super'&&!supers.length)type='normal';

import { beginKnockback, advanceKnockback } from './knockback.js';

/** Stun independently of displacement, respecting knockback resistance and absolute immunity. */
export function applySkillControl(enemy, dx, dy, stunSeconds, travelSeconds, options = {}) {
  enemy.stunRemaining = Math.max(enemy.stunRemaining || 0, stunSeconds);
  enemy.skillKnockback = beginKnockback(enemy, dx, dy, travelSeconds, options);
  enemy.contactReaction = null; enemy.attack = null; enemy.moving = false;
}

/** Resolve stun before AI/contact so a stunned enemy cannot move or damage the player. */
export function updateEnemyControl(enemy, delta, move) {
  if(enemy.frozenRemaining>0){
    enemy.frozenRemaining=Math.max(0,enemy.frozenRemaining-delta);
    if(enemy.frozenRemaining<1e-6)enemy.frozenRemaining=0;

import {tuningPerk} from './tuning-parts.js';
import {applySkillControl} from './enemy-control.js';
export function knockbackTuningMultiplier(player){
  const main=player.mainWeaponId??(player.label==='Plana'?'plana-umbrella':null);
  return main==='plana-umbrella'&&player.tuningParts?1+tuningPerk(player.tuningParts,'knockbackStrengthPercent')/100:1;
}
export function applyTuningKnockback(player,enemy){
  if(!enemy||enemy.hp<=0||!player.tuningParts||knockbackTuningMultiplier(player)===1)return false;
  const frames=tuningPerk(player.tuningParts,'knockbackFrames'),speed=tuningPerk(player.tuningParts,'knockbackSpeed');
  if(!frames||!speed)return false;
  const dx=enemy.x-player.x,dy=enemy.y-player.y,length=Math.hypot(dx,dy),distance=speed*frames;
  applySkillControl(enemy,(length?dx/length:1)*distance,(length?dy/length:0)*distance,0,frames/60);
  return true;
}

/** Despawn only after the complete head bloom and continuous tail clear the current camera. */
export function princessBulletOffscreen(bullet,view) {
  const radius=settings.diameter/2,padding=radius*luminousNovaSettings.bloomRadiusScale;
  const length=Math.min(radius*(1+luminousNovaSettings.trailLengthRatio),settings.speed*bullet.age);
  const tailX=bullet.x-Math.cos(bullet.angle)*length,tailY=bullet.y-Math.sin(bullet.angle)*length;
  return Math.max(bullet.x,tailX)+padding<view.x||Math.min(bullet.x,tailX)-padding>view.x+view.width||
    Math.max(bullet.y,tailY)+padding<view.y||Math.min(bullet.y,tailY)-padding>view.y+view.height;
}

/** Distance fraction: mid-range peak, moderate close throws, a thin far-range tail. */
export function molotovThrowDistance(random=Math.random){
 const min=.05,max=1,mode=.45,u=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,random())),split=(mode-min)/(max-min);
 return u<split?min+Math.sqrt(u*(max-min)*(mode-min)):max-Math.sqrt((1-u)*(max-min)*(max-mode));
}

/** Prefer the nearest enemy in the middle 30-80% of directional screen reach. */
export function molotovLandingPoint(body,view,enemies,random=Math.random){
 const pad=Math.max(view.width,view.height)*.15;
 function reach(angle){const dx=Math.cos(angle),dy=Math.sin(angle);
  const edgeX=Math.abs(dx)>1e-8?((dx>0?view.x+view.width+pad:view.x-pad)-body.x)/dx:Infinity;
  const edgeY=Math.abs(dy)>1e-8?((dy>0?view.y+view.height+pad:view.y-pad)-body.y)/dy:Infinity;
  return Math.max(20,Math.min(edgeX,edgeY));
 }
 let nearest=null,nearestDistance=Infinity;
 for(const enemy of enemies){
  const target=getEnemyHurtbox(enemy),dx=target.x-body.x,dy=target.y-body.y,distance=Math.hypot(dx,dy);
  const fraction=distance/reach(Math.atan2(dy,dx));
  if(fraction>=.3&&fraction<=.8&&distance<nearestDistance){nearest=target;nearestDistance=distance;}
 }
 if(nearest)return {x:nearest.x,y:nearest.y};
 const angle=random()*Math.PI*2,distance=reach(angle)*molotovThrowDistance(random);
 return {x:body.x+Math.cos(angle)*distance,y:body.y+Math.sin(angle)*distance};
}

import { developmentSettings } from './game-config.js';
/** Mix local start time with random entropy so each new run gets a fresh seed. */
export function createRunSeed(time = new Date(), entropy) {
  if (entropy === undefined) {
    entropy = globalThis.crypto?.getRandomValues
      ? globalThis.crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint32Array(1))[0]
      : Math.floor(Math.random() * 4294967296);
  }
  const localTime = [time.getFullYear(), time.getMonth(), time.getDate(),
    time.getHours(), time.getMinutes(), time.getSeconds(), time.getMilliseconds(),
    time.getTimezoneOffset(), entropy].join(':');
  let hash = 2166136261;
  for (const character of localTime) hash = Math.imul(hash ^ character.charCodeAt(0), 16777619);
  return (hash ^ (hash >>> 16)) >>> 0;
}

// Generated once per page/game start; map changes and scene resets reuse it.
export const runStartedAt = new Date();
/** Development starts in admin seed 0; the reroll control opts into a random run. */
export function selectRunSeed(search = '', time = runStartedAt, entropy) {
  const requested = new URLSearchParams(search).get('seed');
  return (requested === null && developmentSettings.adminSeedByDefault) || requested === '0' ? 0 : (createRunSeed(time, entropy) || 1);
}
export const runSeed = selectRunSeed(globalThis.location?.search || '');

// Admin seed bundles tile previews and the 1-HP enemy test configuration.
export const isAdminSeed = runSeed === 0;

import { recordWeaponMax } from './weapon-max-order.js';
import { createMalkuthHat, createRacerPass } from './item-catalog.js';
/** Repeat equip clicks level owned basic weapons; never awaken or enhance them. */
export function equipAdminWeapon(player,createWeapon){
  const candidate=createWeapon(),slots=player.attackSlots??=[],owned=slots.find(w=>w?.id===candidate.id);
  if(owned){
    const maximum=owned.isSynergy?1:(owned.maxLevel??candidate.maxLevel??7);
    const next=Math.min(maximum,(owned.level||1)+1);
    if(next>(owned.level||1)){owned.level=next;recordWeaponMax(player,owned);}
    return true;
  }
  const empty=slots.findIndex(w=>!w);
  if(empty>=0)slots[empty]=candidate;else if(slots.length<6)slots.push(candidate);else return false;
  recordWeaponMax(player,candidate);return true;
}
/** Manual equips bypass reward unlocks without permanently unlocking items. */
export function equipAdminItem(player,item){
  const slots=player.equipmentSlots??=[],owned=slots.findIndex(owned=>owned?.id===item.id),empty=slots.findIndex(owned=>!owned);
  const index=owned>=0?owned:empty>=0?empty:slots.length;
  if(index>=6)return false;slots[index]={...item};return true;
}

/** MAX weapons use their own energy color; awakening remains a separate upgrade. */
export function enhancedWeaponGlow(weapon) {
  if(!weapon||!(weapon.level>=7))return '';
  return weapon.id==='luminous-nova'?'#ff71d5':weapon.id==='aris-laser'?'#65cfff':'';
}

/** Apply the glow to the icon silhouette, never the surrounding inventory box. */
export function applyEnhancedWeaponGlow(element,weapon) {
  const color=enhancedWeaponGlow(weapon);
  element.style.filter=color?`drop-shadow(0 0 2px ${color}) drop-shadow(0 0 5px ${color})`:'';
}

import { skillCastSettings } from './game-config.js';

/** List equipped weapon skills and an optional future ultimate, each with its own timer. */
export function equippedSkills(character) {
  const superWeapon=character.attackSlots?.find(w=>w?.id==='decagrammaton');
  if(superWeapon&&!character.ultimateSkill)character.ultimateSkill={id:'decagrammaton-ultimate',name:'Band of Atsilut',icon:superWeapon.icon,exSkill:true,successCooldown:300};
  if(!superWeapon&&character.ultimateSkill?.id==='decagrammaton-ultimate')delete character.ultimateSkill;
  return [...(character.attackSlots || []), character.ultimateSkill].filter(skill => skill?.icon && skill.exSkill !== false);
}

/** Find availability only; this does not select or equip a weapon. */
export function readySkill(character) {
  return equippedSkills(character).find(skill => !(skill.skillCooldownRemaining > 0));
}

/** Put a cooldown on the exact weapon that initiated a cast, independently of other weapons. */
export function setSkillCooldown(weapon, seconds) {
  weapon.skillCooldownDuration = seconds;
  weapon.skillCooldownRemaining = seconds;
}

/** Tick each equipped weapon once; global pause freezes these timers in the game loop. */
export function advanceSkillCooldowns(characters, delta) {
  const visited = new Set();
  for (const character of characters) for (const weapon of equippedSkills(character)) {
    if (!weapon || visited.has(weapon)) continue;
    visited.add(weapon);
    weapon.skillCooldownRemaining = Math.max(0, (weapon.skillCooldownRemaining || 0) - Math.max(0, delta));
  }
}

/** Drawing-cast state machine; async recognition responses must match the current token. */
export function createSkillCastState(onSubmit = () => {}) {
  let phase = 'idle', owner = null, weapon = null;
  let elapsed = 0, idle = 0, drawing = false, inkLength = 0, token = 0;
  return {
    get phase() { return phase; }, get owner() { return owner; }, get weapon() { return weapon; },
    get token() { return token; }, get inkLength() { return inkLength; },
    get remaining() { return Math.max(0, skillCastSettings.drawingSeconds - elapsed); },
    begin(character, item, adminTest = false) {
      if (phase !== 'idle' || !item?.icon || (!adminTest && item.skillCooldownRemaining > 0)) return false;
      owner = character; weapon = item; elapsed = idle = inkLength = 0; drawing = false;
      phase = 'drawing'; token++;

/** Load the original PNGs once; compose crossed icons directly instead of embedding SVG images. */
export function drawSynergyIcon(canvas,item,isCurrent=()=>true) {
  if(item?.id!=='princess-key')return false;
  const layers=[
    {id:'aris-laser',name:'Arisu',angle:-Math.PI/4,color:'#65cfff',crop:[138,12,678,217]},
    {id:'luminous-nova',name:'Kei',angle:-3*Math.PI/4,color:'#ff71d5',crop:[130,2,716,226]}
  ];
  layers.sort((a,b)=>Number(a.id===item.synergyTopWeaponId)-Number(b.id===item.synergyTopWeaponId));
  Promise.all(layers.map(layer=>{
    const source=`../sprites/attacks/Weapon_Icon_${layer.name}.png`;
    if(!imageCache.has(source)) {
      const image=new Image();image.src=source;
      imageCache.set(source,image.decode().then(()=>image));
    }
    return imageCache.get(source);
  })).then(images=>{
    if(!isCurrent())return;
    const context=canvas.getContext('2d');context.clearRect(0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height);
    layers.forEach((layer,index)=>{
      const [x,y,width,height]=layer.crop;
      const bound=(width+height)/Math.SQRT2,scale=canvas.width*.86/bound;
      context.save();context.translate(canvas.width/2,canvas.height/2);context.rotate(layer.angle);
      context.shadowColor=layer.color;
      // Icons are composed once: layered silhouette glows remain vivid at small HUD sizes.
      for(const blur of [.09,.045,0]) {
        context.shadowBlur=canvas.width*blur;
        context.drawImage(images[index],x,y,width,height,-width*scale/2,-height*scale/2,width*scale,height*scale);
      }
      context.restore();
    });
  }).catch(()=>{});

/** Advance one weapon level; awakening is available only through a Crafter. */
export function applyLevelUpgrade(player, id) {
  ensurePlayerStats(player);
  if (player.pendingUpgrades <= 0 || !rollLevelUpgrades(player,{all:true}).some(choice => choice.id === id)) return false;
  if(id==='molotov-new'||id==='molotov-level'){
    player.attackSlots??=[];
    if(id==='molotov-new'){const empty=player.attackSlots.findIndex(w=>!w);if(empty>=0)player.attackSlots[empty]=createMolotovWeapon();else player.attackSlots.push(createMolotovWeapon());}
    else {const w=player.attackSlots.find(w=>w?.id==='molotov-cocktail');w.level++;recordWeaponMax(player,w);}
    player.pendingUpgrades--;return true;
  }
  if(id==='cooking-new'||id==='cooking-level'){
    player.attackSlots??=[];
    if(id==='cooking-new'){const empty=player.attackSlots.findIndex(w=>!w);if(empty>=0)player.attackSlots[empty]=createBadCookingWeapon();else player.attackSlots.push(createBadCookingWeapon());}
    else {const w=player.attackSlots.find(w=>w?.id==='bad-cooking');w.level++;recordWeaponMax(player,w);}
    player.pendingUpgrades--;return true;
  }
  if(id.startsWith('malkuth-')||id.startsWith('racer-')) {if(!applyItemUpgrade(player,id))return false;player.pendingUpgrades--;return true;}
  const weapon = id.startsWith('luminous-')?getLuminousNova(player):id.startsWith('aris-') ? getArisWeapon(player) : getUmbrella(player);
  if (id === 'aris-new'||id==='luminous-new') {
    player.attackSlots ??= [];
    const empty = player.attackSlots.findIndex(item => !item);
    const acquired=id==='luminous-new'?createLuminousNovaWeapon():createArisWeapon();
    if (empty >= 0) player.attackSlots[empty] = acquired;
    else player.attackSlots.push(acquired);
  } else if (id === 'aris-level') weapon.level = Math.min(arisWeaponSettings.maxLevel, (weapon.level || 1) + 1);
  else if(id==='luminous-level')weapon.level=Math.min(luminousNovaSettings.maxLevel,(weapon.level||1)+1);
  else if (id === 'umbrella-level') weapon.level = Math.min(umbrellaUpgradeSettings.maxLevel, (weapon.level || 1) + 1);
  else return false;
  recordWeaponMax(player,weapon);
  player.pendingUpgrades--;
  return true;

/** Haste changes start-to-start timing only; quantize to60Hz frames, minimum one frame. */
export function attackTimeFormula(baseSeconds, hastePercent = 0, minimumFrames = 1) {
  return Math.max(1, minimumFrames, Math.round(baseSeconds * 60 /
    (1 + Math.max(0, hastePercent) / 100))) / 60;
}

/** MAX weapons use their own energy color; awakening remains a separate upgrade. */
export function enhancedWeaponGlow(weapon) {
  if(weapon?.isSuper)return '#ffd45a';
  if(!weapon||!(weapon.level>=7))return '';
  return weapon.id==='luminous-nova'?'#ff71d5':weapon.id==='aris-laser'?'#65cfff':'';
}

/** Apply the glow to the icon silhouette, never the surrounding inventory box. */
export function applyEnhancedWeaponGlow(element,weapon) {
  const color=enhancedWeaponGlow(weapon);
  element.style.filter=color?`drop-shadow(0 0 2px ${color}) drop-shadow(0 0 5px ${color})`:'';
}

  const next=developerUnlocks&&Boolean(enabled);
  if(next&&!simulateAccount)simulatedUnlocks.clear();
  simulateAccount=next;
}

/** Death protection allows zero HP; use this check when handling player defeat. */
export function isPlayerDefeated(character) {
  ensurePlayerStats(character);
  return character.hp <= 0 && !character.invincible;
}

/** Absorb damage with shield first; spill excess into HP and show one hit number. */
export function damagePlayer(character, amount) {
  ensurePlayerStats(character);
  if (!Number.isFinite(amount) || amount <= 0) return false;
  const damage = Math.round(amount * damageReductionFormula(character.damageReductionPercent ?? []));
  const absorbed = Math.min(character.shield, damage);
  character.shield -= absorbed;

  character.hp = Math.max(0, character.hp - (damage - absorbed));
  const taken = absorbed + previous - character.hp;
  if (taken > 0) {
    character.damageFlashElapsed = 0;
    showDamageNumber(character, taken, true);
  }
  return taken > 0;
}

import { knockbackSettings } from './game-config.js';
import { getCombatHitbox, segmentHitsBody } from './combat-hitboxes.js';

/** Age resistance in gameplay seconds, retaining any configured base resistance. */
export function updateKnockbackResistance(enemy, delta) {
  if (enemy.knockbackIdleSeconds === undefined) return;
  enemy.knockbackIdleSeconds += Math.max(0, delta);
  if (enemy.knockbackIdleSeconds >= knockbackSettings.resetSeconds - 1e-8) enemy.knockbackResistanceBonus = 0;
  enemy.knockbackResistance = Math.min(knockbackSettings.maxResistance,
    Math.max(0, enemy.baseKnockbackResistance || 0) + (enemy.knockbackResistanceBonus || 0));
}

/** Scale speed by existing resistance, then add a stack for subsequent knockbacks. */
export function beginKnockback(enemy, dx, dy, duration, { ignoreKnockbackResistance = false } = {}) {
  // Absolute immunity also blocks attacks that bypass resistance.
  if (enemy.knockbackImmune || !(duration > 0) || !(Math.hypot(dx, dy) > 0)) return null;
  updateKnockbackResistance(enemy, 0);
  const resistance = Math.min(knockbackSettings.maxResistance,
    Math.max(0, enemy.baseKnockbackResistance || 0) + (enemy.knockbackResistanceBonus || 0));
  const scale = ignoreKnockbackResistance ? 1 : 1 - resistance;
  enemy.knockbackResistanceBonus = Math.min(knockbackSettings.maxResistance,
    Math.round(((enemy.knockbackResistanceBonus || 0) + knockbackSettings.resistancePerHit) * 1e6) / 1e6);
  enemy.knockbackIdleSeconds = 0;
  enemy.knockbackResistance = Math.min(knockbackSettings.maxResistance,
    Math.max(0, enemy.baseKnockbackResistance || 0) + enemy.knockbackResistanceBonus);
  return { dx: dx * scale, dy: dy * scale, duration, elapsed: 0, applied: 0, stopped: false };
}

/** Stop displacement without removing an independent stun or contact recovery timer. */
export function stopEnemyKnockback(enemy) {
  if (enemy.skillKnockback) enemy.skillKnockback.stopped = true;
  if (enemy.contactReaction) enemy.contactReaction.stopped = true;
}

/** Repeat equip clicks level owned basic weapons; never awaken or enhance them. */
export function equipAdminWeapon(player,createWeapon){
  const candidate=createWeapon(),slots=player.attackSlots??=[],owned=slots.find(w=>w?.id===candidate.id);
  if(owned){
    const maximum=owned.isSynergy?1:(owned.maxLevel??candidate.maxLevel??7);
    const next=Math.min(maximum,(owned.level||1)+1);
    if(next>(owned.level||1)){owned.level=next;recordWeaponMax(player,owned);}
    return true;

  if(empty>=0)slots[empty]=candidate;else if(slots.length<6)slots.push(candidate);else return false;

}

/** Queue a damage popup; supercritical styling does not define its trigger. */
export function showDamageNumber(target, amount, player = false, hitType = 'normal', group = null) {
  if ((!(amount > 0) && hitType !== 'miss') || !Number.isFinite(amount) || !Number.isFinite(target.x) || !Number.isFinite(target.y)) return;
  // Only the synergy accumulates rapid hits, independently for each enemy and damage source.
  if(group&&hitType!=='miss') {
    const existing=numbers.findLast(number=>number.target===target&&number.group===group&&!number.closed);
    if(existing&&existing.hitType===hitType&&existing.sinceHit<=.3) {
      existing.amount+=amount;existing.sinceHit=0;existing.elapsed=0;
      Object.assign(existing,{scale:1},damageNumberStyle(existing.amount,player,existing.hitType));
      existing.x=target.x;existing.y=target.y-(target.spriteSize||112)*.4;return;
    }
    // A changed hit type ends this run permanently; its popup continues its existing fade.
    if(existing)existing.closed=true;
  }
  if (numbers.length >= damageNumberSettings.maxCount) numbers.shift();
  numbers.push({ ...damageNumberStyle(amount, player, hitType), elapsed: 0,
    x: target.x, y: target.y - (target.spriteSize || 112) * 0.4,
    target,group,amount,hitType,closed:false,sinceHit:0,drift: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 24 });
}

/** Calculate the upward bounce, downward fall, and gradual end fade. */
export function damageNumberPose(number) {
  const t = number.elapsed;
  const progress = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, t / damageNumberSettings.duration));
  const fade = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (t - damageNumberSettings.fadeStart) /
    (damageNumberSettings.duration - damageNumberSettings.fadeStart)));
  return { x: number.x + number.drift * t,
    y: number.y - 4 * damageNumberSettings.jumpHeight * progress * (1 - progress),
    opacity: 1 - fade * fade };
}

/** Expire popups even when their targets die or leave the viewport. */
export function updateDamageNumbers(delta) {
  for (let i = numbers.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    numbers[i].elapsed += delta;
    numbers[i].sinceHit += delta;
    if (numbers[i].elapsed >= damageNumberSettings.duration) numbers.splice(i, 1);
  }
}

/** Cache compact tinted bitmap numbers, preserving the font's dark outline. */
function numberGraphic(text, color) {
  const key = `${text}:${color}`;
  if (textCache.has(key)) return textCache.get(key);
  const glyphs = [...text].map(letter => fontMetrics[letter] || fontMetrics['?']);
  const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
  canvas.width = glyphs.reduce((sum, glyph) => sum + glyph.width - 1, 1);
  canvas.height = 20;
  const context = canvas.getContext('2d');
  let x = 0;
  for (const glyph of glyphs) {
    context.drawImage(font, glyph.x, glyph.y, glyph.width, glyph.height,
      x, glyph.offsetY, glyph.width, glyph.height);
    x += glyph.width - 1;
  }
  if (color !== '#ffffff') {
    const mask = document.createElement('canvas');
    mask.width = canvas.width;
    mask.height = canvas.height;
    mask.getContext('2d').drawImage(canvas, 0, 0);
    context.globalCompositeOperation = 'multiply';
    context.fillStyle = color;
    context.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
// The runtime item effect registers once; plain stat consumers need no world dependencies.
let playerDamageGuard=null;
export function setPlayerDamageGuard(guard){playerDamageGuard=guard;}
/** Absorb damage with shield first; spill excess into HP and show one hit number. */
export function damagePlayer(character, amount) {
  ensurePlayerStats(character);
  if (!Number.isFinite(amount) || amount <= 0) return false;
  const damage = Math.round(amount * damageReductionFormula(character.damageReductionPercent ?? []));
  if(damage<=0)return false;
  if(playerDamageGuard?.(character,damage))return false;
  const absorbed = Math.min(character.shield, damage);
  character.shield -= absorbed;
  const previous = character.hp;
  character.hp = Math.max(0, character.hp - (damage - absorbed));
  const taken = absorbed + previous - character.hp;

import { createBitmapText } from './bitmap-font.js';

import { getLootTotals } from './exp-drops.js';

/** Crop/rotate the actual inventory icon, matching the HUD rather than stretching a sheet. */
function inventoryIcon(target) {
  const canvas=document.createElement('canvas');canvas.width=canvas.height=128;
  canvas.className='crafter-inventory-icon';canvas.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');
  applyEnhancedWeaponGlow(canvas,target);
  if(!target?.icon)return canvas;
  if(drawSynergyIcon(canvas,target))return canvas;
  const image=new Image();
  image.onload=()=>{
    const crop=target.iconCrop||{x:0,y:0,width:image.naturalWidth,height:image.naturalHeight};
    const angle=(target.iconRotation||0)*Math.PI/180;
    const width=Math.abs(crop.width*Math.cos(angle))+Math.abs(crop.height*Math.sin(angle));
    const height=Math.abs(crop.width*Math.sin(angle))+Math.abs(crop.height*Math.cos(angle));
    const scale=116/Math.max(width,height),context=canvas.getContext('2d');
    context.save();context.translate(64,64);if(target.iconFlipX)context.scale(-1,1);context.rotate(angle);
    context.drawImage(image,crop.x,crop.y,crop.width,crop.height,-crop.width*scale/2,-crop.height*scale/2,crop.width*scale,crop.height*scale);context.restore();
  };
  image.src=target.icon;return canvas;
}

/** Initialize session stats once; Development defaults to invincibility on. */
export function ensurePlayerStats(character) {
  character.level ??= 1;
  character.pendingUpgrades ??= 0;
  character.exp ??= 0;
  character.maxExp = experienceForLevel(character.level);
  character.maxHp ??= 100;
  character.hp ??= character.maxHp;
  syncRacerPassHealth(character);
  character.shield = Math.max(0, Math.min(character.maxHp, character.shield ?? 0));
  character.invincible ??= developmentSettings.invincible;
  ensureCombatStats(character);
  return character;
}

/** Add experience, retaining overflow and supporting multiple level-ups per award. */
export function addPlayerExp(character, amount) {
  ensurePlayerStats(character);
  if (!Number.isFinite(amount) || amount <= 0) return;
/** Absorb damage with shield first; spill excess into HP and show one hit number. */
export function damagePlayer(character, amount) {
  ensurePlayerStats(character);
  if (!Number.isFinite(amount) || amount <= 0) return false;
  const damage = Math.round(amount * damageReductionFormula(character.damageReductionPercent ?? []));
  if(damage<=0)return false;
  if(playerDamageGuard?.(character,damage)){showDamageNumber(character,0,true,'miss');return false;}
  const absorbed = Math.min(character.shield, damage);
  character.shield -= absorbed;
  const previous = character.hp;
  character.hp = Math.max(0, character.hp - (damage - absorbed));
  const taken = absorbed + previous - character.hp;
  if (taken > 0) {
    character.damageFlashElapsed = 0;
    showDamageNumber(character, taken, true);
  }
  return taken > 0;
}

/** Heal without exceeding maximum HP; works while invincible. */
export function healPlayer(character, amount) {
  ensurePlayerStats(character);
  if (Number.isFinite(amount) && amount > 0) {
    character.hp = Math.min(character.maxHp, character.hp + Math.floor(amount));
  }
}

/** Heal without exceeding maximum HP; works while invincible. */
export function healPlayer(character, amount) {
  ensurePlayerStats(character);
  if (Number.isFinite(amount) && amount > 0) {
    character.hp = Math.min(character.maxHp, character.hp + Math.floor(amount));
  }
}

export function damageNumberStyle(amount, player = false, hitType = 'normal') {
  if (hitType === 'miss') return { text: 'MISS', color: '#ffffff', italic: true };
  const text = String(Math.round(amount * 100) / 100);

// The runtime item effect registers once; plain stat consumers need no world dependencies.
let playerDamageGuard=null;
export function setPlayerDamageGuard(guard){playerDamageGuard=guard;}
/** Absorb damage with shield first; spill excess into HP and show one hit number. */
export function damagePlayer(character, amount) {
  ensurePlayerStats(character);
  if (!Number.isFinite(amount) || amount <= 0) return false;
  const damage = Math.round(amount * damageReductionFormula([].concat(character.damageReductionPercent??[],lifeJacketStats(character)?.reduction??0)));
  if(damage<=0)return false;
  if(playerDamageGuard?.(character,damage)){character.lastDamageResult={negated:true,healthDamage:0,shieldDamage:0};showDamageNumber(character,0,true,'miss');return false;}
  const jacket=character.lifeJacketState;
  const jacketAbsorbed=Math.min(jacket?.remaining??0,damage);
  if(jacket){jacket.remaining-=jacketAbsorbed;if(jacket.remaining<jacket.capacity)jacket.healElapsed=0;}
  const absorbed = Math.min(character.shield, damage-jacketAbsorbed);
  character.shield -= absorbed;
  const previous = character.hp;
  character.hp = Math.max(0, character.hp - (damage - jacketAbsorbed - absorbed));
  const healthDamage=previous-character.hp;
  const taken = jacketAbsorbed + absorbed + healthDamage;
  character.lastDamageResult={negated:false,healthDamage,shieldDamage:jacketAbsorbed+absorbed};
  if (taken > 0) {
    if(healthDamage>0)character.damageFlashElapsed = 0;
    const shieldDamage=jacketAbsorbed+absorbed;
    if(shieldDamage>0)showDamageNumber(character,shieldDamage,true,'shield');
    if(healthDamage>0)showDamageNumber(character,healthDamage,true);
  }
  return taken > 0;
}

/** Heal without exceeding maximum HP; works while invincible. */
export function healPlayer(character, amount) {
  ensurePlayerStats(character);
  if (Number.isFinite(amount) && amount > 0) {
    character.hp = Math.min(character.maxHp, character.hp + Math.floor(amount));
  }
}

import { createBitmapText } from './bitmap-font.js';
import { survivalTimerSettings } from './game-config.js';

/** Format active survival time as MM:SS, allowing minutes beyond 59. */
export function formatSurvivalTime(seconds) {
  const total = Math.max(0, Math.floor(seconds));
  return `${String(Math.floor(total / 60)).padStart(2, '0')}:${String(total % 60).padStart(2, '0')}`;
}

/** Track a run across map/character switches, pausing with gameplay and ending on death. */
export function createSurvivalClock() {
  let seconds = 0, ended = false;
  return {
    get seconds() { return seconds; },
    advance(delta, paused = false, alive = true) {
      if (paused) return;
      if (!alive) ended = true;
      if (!ended && Number.isFinite(delta)) seconds += Math.max(0, delta);
    }
  };
}

/** Draw survival time at the screen's top center, below the EXP bar. */
export function createSurvivalDisplay() {
  const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
  const text = createBitmapText(canvas, { scale: survivalTimerSettings.fontScale });
  const expBar = document.querySelector('#hud-exp');
  return {
    draw(context, seconds, width, height) {
      text.setText(formatSurvivalTime(seconds));
      const x = Math.max(0, (width - canvas.width) / 2);
      // Read the HUD height so changing the EXP bar also moves the timer.
      const y = Math.max(0, Math.min(height - canvas.height,
        (expBar?.offsetHeight ?? 32) + survivalTimerSettings.offsetBelowExp));
      context.save();
      context.imageSmoothingEnabled = false;
      context.drawImage(canvas, x, y);
      context.restore();
    }
  };
}

/** Roll per-hit critical chance; target debuffs add percentage points before clamping. */
export function rollAttackDamage(character, totalWeaponDamage, random = Math.random,
  { damageMod = 1, forceCritical = false, targetCritBonus = 0, criticalMultiplier, weaponCritDamagePercent = 0, target, weaponId } = {}) {
  const stats = ensureCombatStats(character);
  const buffs=Object.values(character.combatBuffs||{}).filter(Boolean);
  const bonusCrit=buffs.reduce((sum,buff)=>sum+(Number(buff.critPercent)||0),0);
  const critical = forceCritical || random() < Math.max(0, Math.min(100, stats.critPercent + bonusCrit + targetCritBonus - itemCritPenalty(character) + startingWeaponTuning(character,weaponId,'critChancePercent'))) / 100;
  const combinedModifier = damageModifiersFormula({
    criticalMultiplier: critical ? characterCriticalMultiplier(character, criticalMultiplier, weaponCritDamagePercent + startingWeaponTuning(character,weaponId,'critDamagePercent')) : 1,
    bonusDamageTaken: bonusDamageTakenFormula([].concat(target?.bonusDamageTakenPercent??[],target?.weakRemaining>0?target.weakDefensePercent:0)),
    DB: damageBonusFormula([...stats.damageBonusMultipliers,itemDamageBonus(character),...buffs.map(buff=>buff.damageBonusMultiplier).filter(Number.isFinite)]),
    DR: damageReductionFormula(target?.damageReductionPercent ?? []),
    halo: characterHaloMultiplier(character, target),
    attackModifier: damageMod // Attack-specific effects, including EX drawing accuracy.
  });
import {startingWeaponAim} from './tuning-parts.js';
import {rgbTuningActive,rainbowTrailGradient} from './rgb-tuning.js';
import { luminousNovaSkillSettings as skill, luminousNovaSettings, damageRules } from './game-config.js';
import { totalCharacterATK, rollAttackDamage } from './combat-stats.js';
import { getCombatHitbox, getEnemyHurtbox } from './combat-hitboxes.js';
import { onEnemyDamage, getAllEnemies, damageEnemy } from './world-state.js';
import { getLuminousNova, luminousNovaHits, drawLuminousPlasma } from './luminous-nova.js';
import { drawFiringRings } from './firing-rings.js';

const buffKey='luminous-nova-ex';

/** Banked bonus only: no extra ATK or critical roll can exceed this component's cap. */
export function luminousNovaFinisherDamage(damageDealt,player) {
  const baseAttack=damageRules.baseScale*totalCharacterATK(player)/100;
  return Math.max(0,Math.min(Math.round(damageDealt*skill.damageFraction),Math.floor(baseAttack*skill.attackCapMultiplier)));
}

/** Nominal281% ATK before the normal damage roll; the banked extra is calculated separately. */
export function luminousNovaFinisherBaseDamage(player) {
  return Math.max(0,Math.round(damageRules.baseScale*skill.finisherAttackMultiplier*totalCharacterATK(player)/100));
}

/** Own the25s aura, temporary stats, accepted-damage bank and charged finishing shot. */
export function createLuminousNovaSkill({random=Math.random}={}) {
  let state=null;
  const image=new Image();image.src='../sprites/attacks/Weapon_Icon_Kei.png';const ready=image.decode();
  function removeBuff(){if(state?.owner.combatBuffs)delete state.owner.combatBuffs[buffKey];}
  function reset(){removeBuff();state=null;}
  const unsubscribe=onEnemyDamage(({source,damage})=>{
    if(state?.phase==='aura'&&source===state.owner&&Number.isFinite(damage))state.damageDealt+=Math.max(0,damage);
  });
  function cast(player,angle,getAngle=()=>angle) {
    reset();player.combatBuffs??={};
    player.combatBuffs[buffKey]={damageBonusMultiplier:skill.damageBonus,critPercent:skill.critBonus};
    const turn=value=>player.tuningParts?startingWeaponAim(player,'luminous-nova',value):value;
    state={owner:player,phase:'aura',elapsed:0,damageDealt:0,angle:turn(angle),getAngle:()=>turn(getAngle()),hits:new Set()};
  }
  /** Advance on simulation time only, so menus freeze both the buff and the charge. */
  function update(delta,player) {
    if(!state)return;
    if(state.owner!==player||!getLuminousNova(player)){reset();return;}
    let remaining=Math.max(0,delta);
    while(state&&remaining>1e-8) {
      const duration=state.phase==='aura'?skill.duration:state.phase==='opening'?skill.openingSeconds:
        state.phase==='charge'?skill.chargeSeconds:skill.projectileSeconds;
      const step=Math.min(remaining,Math.max(0,duration-state.elapsed));state.elapsed+=step;remaining-=step;
      if(state.burst)state.burst.elapsed+=step;
      if(state.phase==='opening'||state.phase==='charge')state.angle=state.getAngle();
      if(state.phase==='firing') {
        const from={x:state.x,y:state.y};
        state.x+=Math.cos(state.launchAngle)*skill.projectileSpeed*step;
        state.y+=Math.sin(state.launchAngle)*skill.projectileSpeed*step;
        for(const target of getAllEnemies()) {
          if(state.hits.has(target.id)||!luminousNovaHits(target,from,state,skill.projectileDiameter/2*luminousNovaSettings.bloomRadiusScale))continue;
          state.hits.add(target.id);
          const hit=rollAttackDamage(state.owner,skill.finisherAttackMultiplier,random,{target});
          damageEnemy(target.id,hit.damage,state.owner,hit.type);
        }
      }
      if(state.elapsed<duration-1e-8)break;
      if(state.phase==='aura') {
        removeBuff();state.damage=luminousNovaFinisherDamage(state.damageDealt,player);state.phase='opening';state.elapsed=0;
        const center=getCombatHitbox(player,false);state.burst={x:center.x,y:center.y,elapsed:0};

/** Score and queue one campaign transition after its full checkpoint/clock conditions are met. */
function advanceStageAfterClear() {
  if(gachaFiles?.active){awaitingFileStageAdvance=true;return;}
  if(pendingStageTransition) return;
        if (!endlessMode) {
          const result = runScore.complete({character:characters[selected],elapsedSeconds:survivalClock.seconds,
            stage:currentMap,hardcore:characters[selected].hardcore === true});
          window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('run-score-calculated',{detail:result}));
        }
        const next = nextStageAfterBoss(currentMap, endlessMode,
          Object.keys(maps).filter(id => !maps[id].disabled));
        if (next.endless && !endlessMode) {
          endlessMode = true;
          endlessStartedAt = survivalClock.seconds; // Stage 4 completion starts endless timers exactly once.
        }
        pendingStageTransition = next.mapId;
        stageTransitionDelay = stageProgressionSettings.bossClearDelay;
}

/** Add prior beam damage once, after the normal per-hit damage roll. No percentage or cap. */
export function princessBeamTickDamage(base,previousBeamDamage) {
  return Math.max(0,Math.round(base+previousBeamDamage));
}

/** Gentle blue residue pulse, followed by an inward collapse at the four-second detonation. */
export function princessResiduePose(age) {
  const progress=Math.min(1,age/settings.residueSeconds);
  if(age>=settings.residueSeconds) {
    const t=Math.min(1,(age-settings.residueSeconds)/.4);
    return {radius:6+(settings.residueRadius-6)*(1-(1-t)**3),opacity:.24*(1-t)**2,exploded:true};

    opacity:.18*(1-progress*.5)*(.94+.06*Math.sin(age*4)),exploded:false};

export function equippedSkills(character) {
  const superWeapon=character.attackSlots?.find(w=>w?.id==='decagrammaton');

/** Banked bonus only: no extra ATK or critical roll can exceed this component's cap. */
export function luminousNovaFinisherDamage(damageDealt,player) {
  const baseAttack=damageRules.baseScale*totalCharacterATK(player)/100;
  return Math.max(0,Math.min(Math.round(damageDealt*skill.damageFraction*itemSkillDamageMultiplier(player)),Math.floor(baseAttack*skill.attackCapMultiplier)));

import { overclockingStats, itemHpDrainNegated, syncLifeJacketShield } from './item-catalog.js';
/** HP loss, never a hit: bypasses shields except the explicitly enabled Luminous/Life Jacket pair. */
export function updateOverclocking(player,delta){
 const stats=overclockingStats(player);
 if(!stats.drainPercent||itemHpDrainNegated(player)){player.overclockDrainElapsed=0;return;}
 if(!(delta>0)||!Number.isFinite(delta))return;
 player.overclockDrainElapsed=(player.overclockDrainElapsed||0)+delta;
 while(player.overclockDrainElapsed>=1-1e-8){
  player.overclockDrainElapsed-=1;
  let loss=player.maxHp*stats.drainPercent/100;
  if(player.attackSlots?.some(w=>w?.id==='luminous-nova')&&player.equipmentSlots?.some(i=>i?.id==='life-jacket')){
   syncLifeJacketShield(player);const state=player.lifeJacketState;
   const absorbed=Math.min(state?.remaining||0,loss);if(state){state.remaining-=absorbed;if(state.remaining<state.capacity)state.healElapsed=0;}loss-=absorbed;
   const shield=Math.min(Math.max(0,player.shield||0),loss);player.shield=(player.shield||0)-shield;loss-=shield;
  }
  if(player.hp>1)player.hp=Math.max(1,player.hp-loss);
 }
}

export function equipAdminWeapon(player,createWeapon){
  const candidate=createWeapon(),slots=player.attackSlots??=[],owned=slots.find(w=>w?.id===candidate.id);
  if(owned){
    const maximum=owned.isSynergy?1:(owned.maxLevel??candidate.maxLevel??7);
    const next=Math.min(maximum,(owned.level||1)+1);
    if(next>(owned.level||1)){owned.level=next;recordWeaponMax(player,owned);}
    return true;

  const empty=slots.findIndex(w=>!w);
  if(empty>=0)slots[empty]=candidate;else if(slots.length<6)slots.push(candidate);else return false;
  recordWeaponMax(player,candidate);return true;
}
